about.title: About
about.subtitle: Break The Pattern isn't a person. It's a standard.

blocks.d: A brand for repairs, web and technical work others wrote off. Founder-led today, built as a team.
The pattern is settling for average. Slow service, generic templates, vague pricing. We break it.
Technical work can be fast, honest and excuse-free. Most isn't. We prove it can be.
Diagnosis first, then the fix. We understand the problem before we solve it.
More people, services and projects. The standard stays. That's the point.

standards.d: We find the cause first. Then price and timeline, and we hold them.
Components we'll warranty. Not the cheapest substitutes.
Your device comes back cleaner than it arrived. A site, ready to run.

refuse: No billing for work that makes no sense.
about.future: One person becoming a small team, with one standard. Same honesty, more hands, more fields. From repairs to websites to harder technical work.
